title: HookResult
description: The result shape returned by hook points and convention tool calls. See docs/conventions/envelope.md and ADR-0007.

ok.description: True on success. When false, failure_class and message are required.

failure_class.description: Required when ok is false. Drives the engine's retry policy (ADR-0007, ADR-0008).

message.description: Human-readable explanation, required when ok is false.

job_id.description: Present instead of a final result when the call has gone async (docs/conventions/envelope.md#async-jobs).
